CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_assign_conversation(target_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.conversations as conversation

    where conversation.id =
          target_conversation_id

      and private.can_view_conversation(
        conversation.id
      )

      and private.has_permission(
        conversation.organization_id,
        'conversations.assign'
      )

      and (
        conversation.assigned_to =
          (select auth.uid())

        or private.has_permission(
          conversation.organization_id,
          'conversations.read_all'
        )

        or (
          conversation.assigned_to is null

          and private.has_permission(
            conversation.organization_id,
            'conversations.read_unassigned'
          )
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_operate_pipeline(target_pipeline_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.pipelines as pipeline
    where pipeline.id = target_pipeline_id
      and (
        private.has_permission(
          pipeline.organization_id,
          'pipelines.manage'
        )

        or (
          pipeline.status = 'active'
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.pipeline_user_access as access
            where access.pipeline_id = pipeline.id
              and access.organization_id =
                  pipeline.organization_id
              and access.user_id = (select auth.uid())
              and access.access_level in (
                'operate',
                'manage'
              )
          )
        )
      )
  );
$function$

    from public.pipeline_stages as stage
    where stage.id = target_stage_id
      and (
        private.has_permission(
          stage.organization_id,
          'pipelines.manage'

        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.pipeline_user_access as pipeline_access
          where pipeline_access.pipeline_id =
                stage.pipeline_id
            and pipeline_access.user_id =
                (select auth.uid())
            and pipeline_access.access_level in (
              'operate',
              'manage'
            )
            and (
              pipeline_access.stage_scope = 'all'

              or exists (
                select 1
                from public.pipeline_stage_user_access
                  as stage_access
                where stage_access.stage_id = stage.id
                  and stage_access.pipeline_id =
                      stage.pipeline_id
                  and stage_access.user_id =
                      (select auth.uid())
                  and stage_access.access_level = 'operate'

            )
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_view_conversation(target_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.conversations as conversation

    where conversation.id =

        conversation.organization_id
      )

      and (
        private.has_permission(

            'conversations.read_assigned'

            or conversation.created_by =

        )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(target_organization_id uuid, target_permission_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    private.is_platform_admin()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_members as member
      join public.roles as role
        on role.id = member.role_id
        and role.organization_id = member.organization_id
      join public.role_permissions as role_permission
        on role_permission.role_id = role.id
      join public.permissions as permission
        on permission.id = role_permission.permission_id
      where member.organization_id = target_organization_id
        and member.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and member.status = 'active'
        and permission.code = target_permission_code
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notify_inbound_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  responsible_user_id uuid;
begin
  if new.direction <> 'inbound' then
    return new;
  end if;


  select assigned_to
  into responsible_user_id
  from public.conversations
  where id = new.conversation_id
    and organization_id =
        new.organization_id;


  if responsible_user_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;


  insert into public.notifications (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    type,
    title,
    message,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    payload
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    responsible_user_id,
    'conversation.message_received',
    'Nova mensagem recebida',
    case
      when new.body is not null
        then left(new.body, 180)
      else 'Nova mensagem no atendimento'
    end,
    'conversation',
    new.conversation_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'conversation_id',
      new.conversation_id,
      'message_id',
      new.id,
      'message_type',
      new.message_type
    )
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.record_conversation_assignment()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid;
  previous_name text;
  new_name text;
begin
  actor_id := coalesce(
    new.updated_by,
    new.created_by,
    (select auth.uid())
  );


  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then

    if new.assigned_to is not null then

      insert into public.conversation_assignment_history (
        organization_id,
        conversation_id,
        previous_user_id,
        new_user_id,
        changed_by
      )
      values (
        new.organization_id,
        new.id,
        null,
        new.assigned_to,
        actor_id
      );


      insert into public.conversation_user_state (
        organization_id,
        conversation_id,
        user_id
      )
      values (
        new.organization_id,
        new.id,
        new.assigned_to
      )
      on conflict (
        conversation_id,
        user_id
      )
      do nothing;


      insert into public.notifications (
        organization_id,
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        message,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        payload
      )
      values (
        new.organization_id,
        new.assigned_to,
        'conversation.assigned',
        'Nova conversa atribuída',
        coalesce(
          new.subject,
          'Novo atendimento'
        ),
        'conversation',
        new.id,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'conversation_id',
          new.id,
          'lead_id',
          new.lead_id,
          'channel',
          new.channel
        )
      );

    end if;

    return new;
  end if;


  if new.assigned_to is not distinct from
     old.assigned_to then

    return new;

  end if;


  insert into public.conversation_assignment_history (
    organization_id,
    conversation_id,
    previous_user_id,
    new_user_id,
    changed_by
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.id,
    old.assigned_to,
    new.assigned_to,
    actor_id
  );


  if new.assigned_to is not null then

    insert into public.conversation_user_state (
      organization_id,
      conversation_id,
      user_id
    )
    values (
      new.organization_id,
      new.id,
      new.assigned_to
    )
    on conflict (
      conversation_id,
      user_id
    )
    do nothing;


    insert into public.notifications (
      organization_id,
      user_id,
      type,
      title,
      message,
      entity_type,
      entity_id,
      payload
    )
    values (
      new.organization_id,
      new.assigned_to,
      'conversation.transferred',
      'Conversa transferida',
      coalesce(
        new.subject,
        'Atendimento recebido'
      ),
      'conversation',
      new.id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'conversation_id',
        new.id,
        'previous_user_id',
        old.assigned_to,
        'new_user_id',
        new.assigned_to
      )
    );

  end if;


  select full_name
  into previous_name
  from public.profiles
  where id = old.assigned_to;


  select full_name
  into new_name
  from public.profiles
  where id = new.assigned_to;


  insert into public.messages (
    organization_id,
    conversation_id,
    direction,
    message_type,
    body,
    sender_user_id,
    status,
    sent_at
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.id,
    'internal',
    'system',
    format(
      'Atendimento transferido de %s para %s.',
      coalesce(
        nullif(previous_name, ''),
        'Sem responsável'
      ),
      coalesce(
        nullif(new_name, ''),
        'Sem responsável'
      )
    ),
    actor_id,
    'sent',
    now()
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.record_lead_stage_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  event_time timestamptz := pg_catalog.clock_timestamp();
  actor_id uuid;
begin
  actor_id := coalesce(
    new.updated_by,
    new.created_by,
    (select auth.uid())
  );

  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    insert into public.lead_stage_history (
      organization_id,
      lead_id,
      pipeline_id,
      stage_id,
      entered_at,
      entered_by
    )
    values (
      new.organization_id,
      new.id,
      new.pipeline_id,
      new.stage_id,
      event_time,
      actor_id
    );

    return new;
  end if;

  if new.stage_id is distinct from old.stage_id
     or new.pipeline_id is distinct from old.pipeline_id then

    update public.lead_stage_history
    set
      exited_at = event_time,
      duration_seconds = greatest(
        0,
        floor(
          extract(
            epoch from (
              event_time - entered_at
            )
          )
        )::bigint
      )
    where lead_id = new.id
      and organization_id = new.organization_id
      and exited_at is null;

    insert into public.lead_stage_history (
      organization_id,
      lead_id,
      pipeline_id,
      stage_id,
      entered_at,
      entered_by
    )
    values (
      new.organization_id,
      new.id,
      new.pipeline_id,
      new.stage_id,
      event_time,
      actor_id
    );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.record_task_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  action_name text;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then

    insert into public.task_activity_history (
      organization_id,
      task_id,
      action,
      new_status,
      new_assigned_to,
      new_starts_at,
      new_due_at,
      changed_by
    )
    values (
      new.organization_id,
      new.id,
      'created',
      new.status,
      new.assigned_to,
      new.starts_at,
      new.due_at,
      coalesce(
        new.updated_by,
        new.created_by,
        (select auth.uid())
      )
    );

    return new;
  end if;


  if new.status is distinct from old.status then

    action_name := case

      when new.status = 'completed'
        then 'completed'

      when old.status = 'completed'
        and new.status <> 'completed'
        then 'reopened'

      when new.status = 'cancelled'
        then 'cancelled'

      else 'updated'

    end;

  elsif new.assigned_to is distinct from
        old.assigned_to then

    action_name := 'assigned';

  elsif new.starts_at is distinct from old.starts_at
        or new.due_at is distinct from old.due_at then

    action_name := 'rescheduled';

  else

    action_name := 'updated';

  end if;


  insert into public.task_activity_history (
    organization_id,
    task_id,
    action,
    previous_status,
    new_status,
    previous_assigned_to,
    new_assigned_to,
    previous_starts_at,
    new_starts_at,
    previous_due_at,
    new_due_at,
    changed_by
  )
  values (
    new.organization_id,
    new.id,
    action_name,
    old.status,
    new.status,
    old.assigned_to,
    new.assigned_to,
    old.starts_at,
    new.starts_at,
    old.due_at,
    new.due_at,
    coalesce(
      new.updated_by,
      (select auth.uid()),
      new.created_by
    )
  );

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shares_organization_with(target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    private.is_platform_admin()
    or target_user_id = (select auth.uid())
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_members current_member
      join public.organization_members target_member
        on target_member.organization_id =
           current_member.organization_id
      where current_member.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and current_member.status = 'active'
        and target_member.user_id = target_user_id
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.update_conversation_from_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.conversations
  set
    last_message_at = new.sent_at,

    last_message_preview = case
      when new.body is not null
        then left(new.body, 180)

      when new.message_type = 'image'
        then 'Imagem'

      when new.message_type = 'audio'
        then 'Áudio'

      when new.message_type = 'video'
        then 'Vídeo'

      when new.message_type = 'document'
        then 'Documento'

      else 'Nova mensagem'
    end,

    last_message_direction =
      new.direction,

    updated_at = now()

  where id = new.conversation_id
    and organization_id =
        new.organization_id;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_can_access_pipeline(target_user_id uuid, target_pipeline_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.pipelines as pipeline

    join public.organization_members as member
      on member.organization_id =
         pipeline.organization_id

      and member.user_id = target_user_id

      and member.status = 'active'

    where pipeline.id = target_pipeline_id

      and (
        private.user_has_permission(
          target_user_id,
          pipeline.organization_id,
          'pipelines.manage'
        )

        or (
          private.user_has_permission(
            target_user_id,
            pipeline.organization_id,
            'pipelines.read'
          )

          and private.user_has_permission(
            target_user_id,
            pipeline.organization_id,
            'leads.read_all'
          )
        )

        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.pipeline_user_access as access
          where access.pipeline_id = pipeline.id
            and access.organization_id =
                pipeline.organization_id
            and access.user_id = target_user_id
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_has_permission(target_user_id uuid, target_organization_id uuid, target_permission_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles
      where id = target_user_id
        and is_platform_admin = true
    )

    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_members as member

      join public.roles as role
        on role.id = member.role_id
        and role.organization_id = member.organization_id

      join public.role_permissions as role_permission
        on role_permission.role_id = role.id

      join public.permissions as permission
        on permission.id = role_permission.permission_id

      where member.organization_id =
            target_organization_id

        and member.user_id = target_user_id

        and member.status = 'active'

        and permission.code =
            target_permission_code
    );
$function$
